title: Script Modules
description: Validates script module dependencies in behavior pack manifests and package.json files. Checks for version compatibility and can update module versions to the latest supported versions.

100.title: BP Module Dependency
100.description: Reports a script module dependency declared in a behavior pack manifest. Shows the module name and version being used.
100.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the version string. Content field contains the module name.

101.title: Package Dependency
101.description: Reports a @minecraft/* package dependency in package.json. Shows the package name and version used for TypeScript development.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the version string. Content field contains the package name.

102.title: Package Dev Dependency
102.description: Reports a @minecraft/* package devDependency in package.json. Shows the package name and version used for development tooling.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the version string. Content field contains the package name.

110.title: Missing Package Registration
110.description: A script module is used in the behavior pack manifest but not registered in package.json. Add the dependency to package.json.
110.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the module name that is missing from package.json.

111.title: Missing NPM Registration
111.description: A script module is used but could not be found in the NPM registry. Check if the module name is correct.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the module name that could not be found.

114.title: Beta Version Outdated
114.description: The beta version of a script module is outdated compared to the current beta version. Update to the latest beta.
114.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data field contains the outdated version string.
